subject: System Design
title: Image Optimization on the Web
description: A quick, practical guide to Image Optimization on the Web.

hook.text: Images make up 50% of a typical web page's size. Unoptimized images destroy load times.

buildup.text: WebP and AVIF formats compress images 30-50% smaller than JPEG while maintaining visual quality.

discovery.text: Responsive images serve different sizes based on the device. A phone gets a smaller image than a desktop.

twist.text: Lazy loading defers off-screen images until the user scrolls to them, reducing initial page load.

climax.text: Modern image optimization combines format selection, responsive sizing, lazy loading, and CDN delivery.

punchline.text: Right format, right size, right time — images optimized.

quiz.question: Why are WebP and AVIF better than JPEG?
options: They compress 30-50% smaller while maintaining quality
